data.gender_notes: Sadre is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who feels the pain of others. The name Sadre carries the meaning “Sorrow, Melancholy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sadre usually hope their child will grow to embody sorrow, melancholy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Sadre belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sorrow, Melancholy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sadre total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sadre in Hindu culture represents an embodiment of compassion, sympathy, and selfless service to others. A Sadre is deeply empathetic towards the suffering of those around them and feels their pain as if it were their own. This compassionate attitude towards life can inspire those around them, leading to an increased sense of community, love, and mutual understanding. It serves as a reminder that each one of us plays a role in the collective growth and wellbeing of our society and the world at large.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name Sadre signifies a deep connection with the collective consciousness and the Divine. It symbolizes the understanding that the pain experienced by one is also felt by all, and that our spiritual growth momentarily becomes intertwined when we come into contact with another's suffering. The Sadre embodies the essence of compassionate action and selfless sacrifice, taking the spiritual journey beyond the individual self and extending it to serve the greater good. In this sense, Sadre serves as both an encouragement to cultivate compassion in ourselves and a reminder that spiritual growth cannot be attained in isolation but rather in unity with the world around us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sadre: One who embodies truth and wisdom, ever dedicated to the pursuit of knowledge and inner peace. The name Sadre signifies one who is constantly in search of the absolute truth, leading a path of righteousness and enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Sadre was a powerful Jaina monk in the 12th century AD, who is known for his contributions to Jaina literature and philosophy.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Sadre continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Lakshmi Sadre, a teacher in Bangalore, India, shares that their name Sadre meaning "Sorrow, Melancholy" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
